title: Web$hell: A Unified Interface for Agentic Web Access
abstract: arXiv:2610.13416v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are becoming direct users of the open web. As they take on increasingly complex and information-intensive tasks, effective web access is becoming a core capability for agentic problem solving. Existing approaches have advanced agentic web access through different access models, including search-augmented agents, browser-based agents, and, more recently, filesystem-based agents. Nevertheless, as users expect agents to complete long-horizon, end-to-end tasks, they increasingly need to conduct broad information gathering, perform browser actions, and revisit acquired evidence within a single trajectory. Yet our preliminary analyses reveal that existing access models struggle to meet these demands. They primarily support either information gathering or browser interaction, while combining their capabilities can involve substantial costs or performance trade-offs. translated_title: Web$hell：智能体网页访问的统一接口
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体正在成为开放网页的直接用户。随着它们承担越来越复杂、信息密集的任务，有效的网页访问正成为智能体问题求解的核心能力。现有方法通过不同的访问模式推进了智能体网页访问，包括搜索增强型智能体、基于浏览器的智能体，以及近期的基于文件系统的智能体。然而，随着用户期望智能体完成长时程、端到端的任务，它们越来越需要在同一条任务轨迹内进行广泛的信息收集、执行浏览器操作，并重新审视已获取的证据。我们的初步分析表明，现有访问模式难以满足这些需求：它们主要只支持信息收集或浏览器交互二者之一，而将两者能力结合起来往往伴随巨大的成本或性能折衷。为此，我们提出了Web$hell，一个面向智能体网页访问的统一接口。
tldr: 提出Web$hell——一个统一搜索增强、浏览器与文件系统等多种访问模式的智能体网页访问接口，使智能体能够在单条任务轨迹内同时完成信息收集、浏览器操作和证据回溯。
en_tdlr: Web$hell is a unified interface for agentic web access that integrates search-augmented, browser-based, and filesystem-based access models, enabling LLM agents to gather information, perform browser actions, and revisit evidence within a single trajectory.
